description: For somebody who leads a team that does the same work every day. Needs nothing but this phone. The huddle has a timer, which reaches you with a card; set one to wake you if the phone will be face down.
name: A manager's daily round

steps.description: Standing, at the place where the work is. Yesterday, today, what is in the way. Nobody sits.
steps.title: Hold the huddle

steps.description: The one the team can see too, against its target. Say it out loud before you say why.
steps.title: Look at the one number

steps.description: Go to where the work happens, not to the report. Watch one piece of work from start to end.
steps.title: Walk the process

steps.description: Pick one finished item you did not choose beforehand and check it all the way. Note what you found.
steps.title: Check one sample

steps.description: By name, for one specific thing they did. "Good job" does not count.
steps.title: Praise one person

steps.description: One, not a list. Say who and when, and write it where they will see it.
steps.title: One follow-up, with an owner and a day
